preconditions.description: The input A is a positive integer between 1 and 10^12 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for x in range(1, A + 1) if sum(d for d in divisors(x) if d <= x) == A)
postconditions.description: The output is the count of distinct positive integers x such that the sum of all divisors of x (including 1 and x itself) equals A.
